purpose: Machine-readable rules for generating a complete multi-sensor display system and, when needed, installing an offline sandboxed display app without changing Shroom's permanent backend pipeline.

normativeLanguage.MUST: required; failure stops generation or installation
normativeLanguage.MAY: optional only when all MUST rules remain satisfied

requiredReadOrder.responseShape: raw contract object; this endpoint is not wrapped in HttpResult and has no data prefix
requiredReadOrder.rule: MUST read the live SDK contract before selecting routes, schemas, protocol presets, channels, or built-in renderers. Do not rely on remembered values.
MUST read the installed policy and stop when its schemaVersion or required capabilities are unsupported.
MUST inspect installed app ids before installation. Existing apps are not overwritten by default.

changeBoundary.rule: A display app is installed as local data files through the public API. It MUST NOT patch application source or create a second acquisition pipeline.
forbiddenActions: modify the Electron bridge, preload, IPC, backend, SDK contract, serial lifecycle, parser, storage, playback, CSV, or WebSocket gateway
write directly into build, asar, application installation, database, or runtime internal directories
open a serial port, SQLite database, raw WebSocket, shell, child process, or Electron IPC from renderer code
create a second protocol catalog, frame envelope, storage format, replay path, or CSV path

allowedKinds.idRule: Use an exact renderer id returned by the live SDK contract or platform catalog. MUST NOT guess or hardcode an unavailable built-in id.
The platform creates this stable rendererId after the app is installed; appId is manifest.id.

rendererSelection.customRendererWhen: Use an agent renderer only when the requested presentation cannot be expressed by a currently advertised built-in renderer.

entry.rule: MUST be a portable relative path present in install.files; no traversal, absolute path, URL, or backslash alias.

permissions.rule: Permissions are host capabilities, not browser APIs. sensor.read only supplies sanitized init/frame messages. An explicitly empty array is invalid.

httpEnvelope.transportExceptions: Malformed JSON and a request body larger than the host-wide 50 MiB parser limit are rejected before the Agent Apps route and may use the host's legacy raw {error} transport response. Treat any non-2xx response as failure before reading HttpResult fields.

rules: manifest is the parsed app.json and MUST NOT also be supplied as files/app.json
renderer.entry MUST exist in files
encoding MUST be utf8 or base64
overwrite MUST remain false unless the user explicitly authorizes replacement of that exact app id
all files and dependencies MUST be packaged locally; network URLs and runtime downloads are forbidden
browser installation requests MUST originate from a loopback page; a native local Agent or CLI may omit Origin

staticFile.response: raw local file with a safe content type
staticFile.rule: Renderer files are served only from the installed app directory after path validation.

sandbox.iframeRule: The host runs agent renderer HTML in a sandbox. The renderer MUST accept data only when event.source === window.parent.
sandbox.originModel: The iframe has an opaque origin. Static app responses use Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: cross-origin so package files can load; isolation relies on sandbox flags, exact app-files CSP, path validation, and the postMessage source check rather than same-origin trust.

securityBoundary.purpose: capability isolation for trusted packaged renderer code
notGuaranteed: absolute CPU or memory denial-of-service protection
securityBoundary.reviewRequirement: Renderer source and packaged assets MUST be reviewed before installation. Do not install intentionally hostile, obfuscated, or resource-exhausting code.

sandbox.samePackageResourceAccess: MAY use fetch only for a relative file inside the current installed app when the live policy/host advertises the exact /api/agent-apps/:id/files/ prefix. This is local package access, not network authority.
sandbox.contentSecurityPolicyAuthority: The host's dynamic HTTP response header is authoritative. Renderer files MUST NOT try to weaken or replace it; an HTML meta CSP is neither required nor sufficient and can accidentally block opaque-origin package assets.

requiredHostContentSecurityPolicy.script-src: the exact current-app /api/agent-apps/:id/files/ prefix; inline script is forbidden

connect-src.allowedException: the exact current-app /api/agent-apps/:id/files/ prefix advertised by the live host

forbiddenApis: fetch or XMLHttpRequest to any URL outside the exact host-provided current-app static resource prefix

payloadFields.serial: read-only sanitized object declared by serialMetadata|null
payloadFields.channels: optional array of channel items declared by multiChannelExtension

multiChannelExtension.compatibility: The top-level frame payload remains the current widget route. A host may additionally include channels; a missing channels field is a valid single-channel v1 message.

itemFields.serial: read-only sanitized object declared by serialMetadata|null

rules: Every item MUST have a canonical identity and state MUST be keyed by full channelId.
The renderer MAY combine channels for one visualization but MUST NOT infer roles from array order.
The top-level current route remains available and MUST continue to work when channels is absent.
The host rebuilds every payload from a whitelist and sends JSON-safe data only.
The renderer MUST reject unsupported schemaVersion values.
init MUST be accepted before frame, MUST be idempotent, and the renderer SHOULD emit ready after every valid init so a lost startup ready can recover.
frame.channelId MUST equal the initialized channelId.
channelId MUST equal displaySystemId + ':' + sensorId.
The renderer MUST NOT mutate, reinterpret, or send sensor data back to the host.
serial is optional, read-only diagnostic metadata and may change after reconnect
serial MUST NOT contain handles, functions, parser objects, Electron objects, or unlisted properties
serial role, portId, path, parserChannel, status, and array position MUST NOT define or infer business identity
left/right/backrest/seat identity remains the explicit sensorId, sensorLabel, outputChannel, and canonical channelId

sensorData.sensorLabelSource: The host-provided sensorLabel, originating from the matching sensors[].label; fallback is sensorId.
sensorData.businessRoleRule: MUST NOT infer left hand, right hand, backrest, seat, or another role from serial role, portId, COM path, parserChannel, port order, protocol id, output arrival order, or array index.
sensorData.canonicalValuesSource: sensor.frame.payload.value projected by the host as frame.payload.values and, when present, frame.payload.channels[].values
sensorData.legacyRule: MUST NOT read, generate, or depend on top-level sitData/backData/headData. They are input-only aliases inside the platform compatibility boundary.
sensorData.multiSensorRule: Keep state keyed by full channelId. Frames from different sensors or reconnect order MUST NOT overwrite each other; channels array position has no identity meaning.

displaySystemGeneration.purpose: Generate a complete schema-v3 display system whose protocol, per-sensor mapping, algorithm, renderer, widgets, charts, realtime, storage, playback, and CSV all remain on the permanent platform pipeline.

requiredDiscovery.requiredData: catalog including supported renderers, algorithms, chart templates, serial templates, limits, and writable capabilities
the live protocol preset catalog; do not maintain a second list
existing display-system ids and runtime status

sensorRules: sensors MUST be a non-empty array and every id MUST be explicit, stable, unique, trimmed, and contain no colon
label is the business sensorLabel and MUST be explicit; never derive it from COM, protocol, or position
outputChannel MUST be explicit, non-empty, trimmed, and unique across sensors
stored MUST be explicit; false means realtime only and true enables the existing storage/replay/CSV path
matrix is display geometry and MUST NOT rewrite protocol.decoding.valueCount or a fixed protocol.framing.frameLength
files MUST point to that sensor's definitions; multi-sensor systems SHOULD use <sensorId>/ subdirectories
protocol MUST be the complete normalized selected/detected preset rather than a partial UI projection
algorithm MUST select an existing pipeline mode; arbitrary code follows algorithmPolicy

<sensorId>.lineOrder: object or array for this sensor only

rules: definitions.sensors keys MUST exactly match manifest sensors[].id
Each route keeps its own line order, point order, coordinate map, algorithm data, and authorized algorithm source
Do not place only the first sensor's definition at the top level and project it over other sensors
Line order, geometry transform, and algorithm execute once in the existing backend pipeline

request.candidateIds: optional ids from the live preset catalog

rules: Only matched may populate the current sensor protocol, and it MUST copy the complete returned protocol
ambiguous and unknown preserve the draft and require manual selection or more evidence
Detection identifies a wire protocol only; it MUST NOT assign left/right/backrest/seat or another business identity
The temporary COM path is not saved into the display-system manifest
Explicit protocol.decoding.valueCount and fixed protocol.framing.frameLength MUST survive save unchanged even when matrix or point count differs

display.widgetSourceRule: Every data widget in a multi-sensor system MUST explicitly set source to that sensor's exact outputChannel. New manifests SHOULD use outputChannel itself, not a *Data suffix or array position.
display.rendererRule: Use an exact built-in renderer advertised by the catalog, or first install an agent app and use its stable agent:<appId> renderer id.
display.profileRule: Every profile renderer reference and widget id MUST resolve to a declared renderer/widget.

charts.builtin: Use catalog-advertised chartCards/templates and supported formula syntax; at most the live catalog limit.
charts.agent: An agent renderer MAY draw local presentation-only charts from its init/frame values, metrics, algorithmMetrics, and optional channels array.
charts.dataRule: Chart rendering does not create another storage or analysis truth; persisted/exported values remain those from the permanent pipeline.

rules: overwrite MUST remain false unless the user explicitly authorizes replacing this exact display-system id
On conflict, choose another id or stop; do not retry silently with overwrite true
After save, call the contract-advertised reload route and read the editor/detail response to verify every sensor round-tripped independently

acceptance: Every configured sensor has a distinct canonical channelId, visible sensorLabel, explicit widget source, and its own geometry/definitions
Protocol valueCount, fixed frameLength, includeDelimiter, headerOffset, checksum offset, and explicit checksum range round-trip unchanged
Realtime values, stored data, replay values, and CSV realData match per canonical channelId for stored:true sensors
stored:false sensors publish realtime but do not appear in storage, replay, or CSV
Multi-rate playback uses platform alignment and renderer state never depends on channels array order
No permanent backend, contract, database, WebSocket, playback, or CSV implementation was modified

allowedWithoutAdditionalAuthorization: an algorithm or declarative operation already exposed by the live platform contract and executed in the existing pipeline
explicitAuthorizationRequired: new executable, WASM, native library, DLL, shell command, package, or runtime dependency
rules: Renderer HTML is presentation-only and MUST NOT implement an alternate acquisition, calibration, storage, replay, or CSV algorithm.
Authorized JavaScript or Python algorithms MUST run through the existing platform algorithm host and permanent frame pipeline, with its validation and timeout controls.
If explicit authorization is absent, stop or use an existing declared algorithm; never silently embed code in the renderer.

overwritePolicy.rule: MUST list installed apps first. Replacing an existing id requires explicit user authorization naming that id; otherwise choose a new id or stop.

requiredChecks: GET /api/sdk/contract succeeds and required contract versions are supported
app.json and policy.json parse as strict JSON
manifest id and renderer id satisfy the exact safe-kebab pattern
renderer.entry and every referenced local script or asset are each included once in files; every path is local, portable, relative, and within limits

The host response has the required restrictive CSP; renderer HTML does not add a conflicting meta CSP, contains no external URL, and any optional fetch is restricted to the exact current-app static resource prefix
renderer accepts init idempotently, replies ready after each valid init, then renders frame.payload.values and safely keys optional frame.payload.channels by full channelId
renderer reports invalid messages with shroom.renderer.error and does not render them
canonical channelId and sensorLabel remain visible and frames from another channel are rejected
installation uses overwrite:false unless exact replacement was explicitly authorized
the permanent backend and stable contract have no source changes
